subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the ancient-Chinese female dao fighter in <Picture 1>: an early-20s Chinese woman with an oval face, slender sword-shaped eyebrows, sharp confident phoenix eyes, a straight high nose, and red lips. Her black hair is tied in a high ponytail with a deep-red ribbon, loose strands falling across her forehead. She wears a deep-red-and-black fitted combat robe with a crossed collar and waist sash, a black leather belt with a silver buckle, and a translucent red silk cape that snaps in the wind. Her only weapon is a SINGLE single-edged dao, a long Chinese saber with a gently curved single-edged, cold-gleaming blade and a red tassel at the pommel, held only in her right hand; she never carries or draws a second blade of any kind.
<Subject 2> is the cyberpunk gunfighter in <Picture 2>: an early-20s woman with refined sharply defined features, a high straight nose, slightly pressed lips, and a cold sharp composed gaze. She has medium-short silver-white hair with electric-blue and neon-purple tips and faint glowing cyber-implant lines at her temples and neck. She wears a black matte tech suit with electric-blue and magenta neon strip patterns, lightweight mechanical armor on her shoulders and elbows, a metal tactical belt, and futuristic mechanical high-heel combat boots. She fights exclusively with her TWIN energy pistols, one streamlined energy pistol in each hand, their barrels giving off a cold neon glow.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is an 8.00-second pursuit battle that never stops: <Subject 2> retreats and fires both pistols while <Subject 1> chases and deflects with her single dao, a single 0.4-second bullet-time close-up isolates a near-miss round, and the chase climbs into a wall run and a mid-air clash. The segment ends on both fighters landing and pivoting toward each other.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - her design, cape, and single dao are retained, with exactly one blade visible in every frame.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - her design, neon strips, and twin energy pistols are retained, with both pistols always in her hands.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a photorealistic cinematic live-action style with digital-photography-level clarity, anamorphic shallow depth of field, and a clean crisp render. The ruined arena provides a vertical playground: fallen pillars, a broken wall with a tilted face, and neon haze streaming past as both fighters keep moving at full speed.
[Shot 1] The segment opens in mid-action: the two fighters sprint straight at each other and, at the instant of contact, <Subject 2> jukes sideways into a wide retreating arc, firing rapid rounds from both pistols while <Subject 1> chases in a zig-zag with her single dao, deflecting bullets off the edge and ducking under the last two; they cross the entire arena, the gunner vaulting a fallen pillar without breaking her firing rhythm and the dao fighter sliding under the same pillar in pursuit. [Shot 2] At 00:02.600, a 0.4-second bullet-time close-up freezes one instant of the chase: a glowing round hangs centimeters from <Subject 1>'s ear as she leans through the dodge, hair, dust, and a torn banner petal suspended in the air while the camera orbits her face with small amplitude at slow speed; time snaps back to full speed and she lands from the dodge already running, twisting to face the retreating gunner. [Shot 3] At 00:04.400, the chase goes vertical: <Subject 2> sprints up the tilted face of the broken wall, flips backward off the top firing downward with both pistols; <Subject 1> runs up the opposite fallen pillar and launches off its edge, the two colliding mid-air at frame center, the single dao edge meeting the crossed gun barrels in a burst of sparks that sends them tumbling apart in opposite arcs; both land already running, immediately pivot, and accelerate back toward each other. The segment closes on this second sprint-to-clash until the final frame at 08.000.

overall_soundscape:
Rapid gunfire cracks through the pursuit with a rising bullet-whine on each near-miss, the dao hisses on deflections, boots and high heels pound stone and scrape up the wall faces, the mid-air clash rings with a metallic screech, and both fighters hit the ground running with heavy footfall impacts.

non_diegetic_music:
The percussion keeps a relentless driving pulse under the chase, the score drops to a single low sub-bass note during the 0.4-second bullet-time, and a drum roll with a brass stab lands on the mid-air clash before the rhythm accelerates again into the closing sprint.
